decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (western and eastern flank) walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the part-width single-storey rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The window formed in the side roof extension hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, as is shown on the approved drawings, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a side and rear roof extension and part-width single storey rear extension to existing house.
